body: # U.S. Economy Overview at a Glance. ## Uploaded by. AI-enhanced title and description. The document provides a summary of key economic indicators for the United States as of April 2025, including unemployment rates, payroll employment changes, average hourly earnings, and price indices. It highlights monthly and quarterly data trends, such as a slight increase in the unemployment rate and fluctuations in consumer and producer price indices. The data is sourced from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics and includes both preliminary and revised figures. ## Share this document. ## Footer menu. ## Support. ## Legal. ## Social. ## Get our free apps. Real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 2.1 percent in the first quarter of 2026 (January, February, and March), according to the third estimate released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis. In the fourth quarter of 2025, real GDP increased 0.5 percent. Personal income increased $181.6 billion (0.7 percent at a monthly rate) in May, according to estimates released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). The U.S. current-account deficit resulting from international economic transactions widened by $5.8 billion, or 2.6 percent, to $226.8 billion in the first quarter of 2026, according to statistics released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis. The U.S. net international investment position, the difference between U.S. residents’ foreign financial assets and liabilities, was –$21.27 trillion at the end of the first quarter of 2026. The U.S. monthly international trade deficit decreased in April 2026 according to the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and the U.S. Census Bureau.
